texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]检测到轨道中有一个自动化船坞的残骸。这个船坞至少有一千年的历史了，并且曾经被重型导弹轮番轰炸过，所幸的是其中一个船坞仍可以使用。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]确信能够恢复船坞的电力，但过程会比较复杂。
texts.en:
While conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] detected the remains of an automated shipyard in orbit. It is at least a thousand years old and seems to have been subjected to a heavy missile barrage, but one of its manufacturing bays is still in working condition.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that power can be restored to the shipyard, but it would be a significant project.

texts.zh:
在调查[From.GetName]的过程中，[Root.GetName]有了个惊人的发现：一个古老而凋败的太空孕育摇篮的遗迹；这是一座巨大的有机结构，它曾经可以制造星际飞船。它在寂静中漂流，外膜破裂萎缩，这似乎是在几个世纪前的残酷轰炸中发生的。它的大部分管路组织都石化了，神经网络没有反应……然而，还有一个孕育室仍在微弱地蠕动着，它的反应堆缓慢地跳动着剩余的生命。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]相信，只要小心地介入，我们也许可以复活这个沉睡的生命，至少部分复活。然而，这会是一件颇费时间的工程，不可预见的生物响应风险也不能忽视。
texts.en:
While surveying [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] has made an astonishing discovery: the decayed remains of an ancient, spaceborne gestation cradle; a vast organic structure once capable of birthing starships. It drifts in silence, its outer membranes ruptured and withered from what appears to have been a brutal bombardment, likely centuries ago. Most of its vascular conduits are petrified, its neural lattice unresponsive... and yet, one gestation chamber still stirs faintly, its reactors sluggishly pulsing with residual life.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that, with careful intervention, we may be able to revive this slumbering entity, at least partially. However, it will be a delicate and time-consuming process, and the risk of unforeseen biological responses cannot be ignored.

texts.zh: 一个老旧的自动化船坞的残骸被发现在[From.GetName]的轨道上。工程师认为他们可以让其中一个保存完好的制造港恢复电力。
texts.en: The remains of an old automated shipyard have been found orbiting [From.GetName]. Our engineers believe that they can restore power to the shipyard's sole surviving manufacturing bay.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]成功恢复了[From.From.From.GetName]上自动化造船厂的电力。船厂很快就恢复了之前被中断的生产程序，使用现有的材料建造了三艘结构未知的掠袭者战舰。

可惜在这之后这个古老的造船厂发生了无法修复的严重故障。因此我们只能选择接管这三艘飞船，让其加入我们的舰队。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] has successfully restored power to the automated shipyard over [From.From.From.GetName]. The facility immediately resumed its interrupted construction order, using what materials it had on hand to build three advanced raiders of an unknown design.

Unfortunately, the ancient facility broke down completely afterwards and has been deemed beyond repair. We have sent crews to the new ships and commissioned them into our fleet.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]成功复苏了围绕着[From.From.From.GetName]的休眠摇篮。常年闲置的生物锻造器突然复苏使这个古老的有机结构颤抖起来，它匆忙地完成了三头战兽的生长周期，它们的设计都是未知的，但却异常复杂。

然而，这种意想不到的重生对这个衰老的有机体来说，压力太大了。它的维管崩溃，神经中枢枯萎，溶解成惰性的生物质。新组建的舰队虽然一开始迷失了方向，但很快便适应了我们的存在。它们被整合进我们的舰队，迫不及待地为新的共生主体建功立业了。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] has successfully reawakened the dormant cradle orbiting [From.From.From.GetName]. The ancient, organic structure trembled as its long-idle bio-forges surged to life, hastily completing the growth cycle of three warforms, each an unknown yet eerily sophisticated design.

However, the strain of this unexpected rebirth proved too much for the aged organism. Its vascular conduits collapsed, its neural core withered, and it dissolved into inert biomass. The newly formed ships, though disoriented at first, quickly adapted to our presence. They have been integrated into our fleet, eager to serve their new symbiotic masters.

summary.text:
# 远古船坞 / Ancient Shipyard

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:603; events/anomaly_events_2.txt:569 (anomaly.2550); common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt (AUTOMATED_SHIPYARD_PROJECT); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:609 (anomaly.2551); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:673 (anomaly.2552)

## 如何开始 How it starts

不宜居的普通星球可能生成（4级，权重1）。

Can spawn on a regular uninhabitable planet (level 4, weight 1).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 anomaly.2550“自动化船坞”：选项启用项目 AUTOMATED_SHIPYARD_PROJECT“修复自动化船坞”（180天；不需要科学船，需要建造舰或方舟舰队，triggered_requirement）。完成后随机（各50%）：anomaly.2551（获得三艘 R44 海盗设计舰船 Specter/Ghost/Wraith）或 anomaly.2552（获得一艘 F79 设计舰船 Dark Wanderer）。

Single result anomaly.2550 "Automated Shipyard": the option enables project AUTOMATED_SHIPYARD_PROJECT (180 days; it needs a constructor ship or ark-ship fleet via triggered_requirement, not a science ship). On completion it picks at random (50% each) anomaly.2551 (three R44-design pirate-style ships Specter/Ghost/Wraith) or anomaly.2552 (one F79-design ship Dark Wanderer).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

项目结果 2551/2552 互斥。

Project results 2551/2552 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

2550 / 2551 的描述有生物舰船变体。

2550 and 2551 have bio-ship description variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
